title: Conveyancing Paralegal
description:
This is a great time to join a growing Residential Conveyancing team in Glasgow.

Following continued growth and further expansion of the team, I am looking to speak with experienced Residential Conveyancing Paralegals who would like to join a firm that is genuinely going places, but which has retained a relaxed, supportive and very grown up approach to how people work.

For someone who enjoys managing their own caseload and wants the autonomy to get on with their job without being micromanaged, I think this is a particularly attractive opportunity.

You will manage your own residential conveyancing caseload from instruction through to completion, dealing directly with clients and taking ownership of your transactions. You will have experienced people around you when you need them, but equally you will be trusted to manage your workload and your clients in your own way.

What really stands out to me is the culture.

This is a supportive, friendly environment where people are treated like adults. There is good flexibility and, following an initial settling in period, the opportunity to work on a hybrid basis. Just as importantly, this is a firm that wants its people to develop and actively encourages progression and growth.

With the team continuing to expand, it is a really good time to come on board and be part of what they are building.

You should have at least a years experience managing your own residential conveyancing caseload and be comfortable handling transactions from start to finish.

Alongside a competitive salary, the firm offers good flexibility, private healthcare and a discretionary bonus.

If you are an experienced Residential Conveyancing Paralegal in Glasgow and would like to join a growing team where you will be trusted, supported and given the opportunity to develop, please get in touch with me for a confidential conversation.

title: Family Paralegal
description:
Join an award-winning firm as a Family Law Paralegal, playing a key role in delivering an outstanding client experience.

If you're a Family Law Paralegal with at least 2 years' experience, this is a great opportunity to join a forward-looking firm where people genuinely enjoy the culture - built around care, drive, integrity, passion and putting clients first.

What's on offer?
- Hybrid working
- Private health scheme
- Life assurance
- Income protection
- Bonus scheme
- Regular staff celebrations, rewards and social days out

The role
As Family Law Paralegal, you'll get involved in every stage of family law casework, including:
- Booking client appointments and keeping them in the loop
- Taking precognitions and coordinating witnesses
- Drafting Minutes of Agreement and other legal documents
- Helping prepare Affidavits
- Putting together schedules of matrimonial property and checking vouching
- Handling correspondence with clients and other parties

About you
- At least 2 years' experience in family law
- Driven and motivated to deliver a first-class client experience
- Great people skills
- Comfortable working towards KPI targets
- Personable, detail-focused and confident
- Happy to pitch in and support the wider team

The environment
You'll be joining a firm that puts real value on its people with regular recognition, rewards and social events, all underpinned by a culture of care, drive, integrity, passion and client focus.

If you're a Family Law Paralegal considering your next move, we would welcome a confidential chat.

How to Apply:

Online: Submit your updated CV via the application link provided.
Contact: For immediate consideration contact Becky Newton at G2 Legal.

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Accounts Administrator
description:
Temporary Accounts / Admin Assistant

Location: Fully onsite - Scotstoun
Hours: Circa 25 hours per week - flexible around working hours
Contract: Temporary, initially for a couple of months
Start: ASAP

Are you an experienced Accounts Administrator or Accounts Assistant looking for a temporary opportunity within a friendly, close-knit business?

We're currently recruiting for a Temporary Accounts / Admin Assistant to provide additional support to a small, family-run business during a period of change.

The business is preparing to introduce new systems, with implementation planned for 1 December, so this is a great opportunity for someone who can come in, get up to speed quickly and help keep the day-to-day accounts and office administration running smoothly during the transition.

The Role

Working as part of a small team, you'll provide hands-on support across accounts, administration and general office duties, including:
- Processing purchase invoices and supporting the purchase ledger
- Raising customer invoices and assisting with the sales ledger
- Dealing with supplier and customer queries via phone and email
- Keeping Sage 50 records accurate and up to date
- Supporting with credit control where required
- Filing, scanning and maintaining accurate records
- Data entry and updating internal systems
- General office administration and organisation
- Answering and directing telephone calls
- Managing incoming and outgoing correspondence
- Assisting with general office tasks and keeping the office organised
- Supporting the wider team with ad hoc administrative duties
- Helping to keep day-to-day processes organised during the transition to new systems

About You

We're looking for someone who is practical, reliable and organised, with the confidence to work independently in a small business environment.

You'll need:
- Previous hands-on accounts and administration experience
- Strong experience using Sage 50 - this is essential
- Good attention to detail and accurate data entry skills
- Confidence dealing with customers and suppliers
- Good telephone and communication skills
- The ability to manage your own workload and work with minimal supervision
- A flexible, hands-on approach and willingness to get involved wherever needed

Experience using Xero would be advantageous but is not essential.

Credit control experience would also be beneficial, although this is not a requirement.

What's on offer?
- Temporary assignment initially for around 3 months
- Circa 25 hours per week
- Flexible working hours to suit the successful candidate
- Fully onsite within a small, friendly team
- Immediate opportunity to provide valuable support during a period of systems change
- Potential for the assignment to extend depending on business requirements

If you're an experienced Accounts/Admin professional with strong Sage 50 experience and you're looking for a flexible temporary opportunity, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or contact Gemma at Iconic Resourcing for more information.

title: Conveyancing Paralegal
description:
Residential Conveyancing Paralegal

Location: Glasgow
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience
Contract: Full-time, Permanent

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Residential Conveyancing Paralegal to join our client, a well-established legal firm based in Glasgow. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong background in conveyancing who is looking to develop their career within a supportive and dynamic environment.

Key Responsibilities:
- Managing a caseload of residential conveyancing matters from instruction to completion.
- Drafting and reviewing legal documents, including contracts and title deeds.
- Liaising with clients, estate agents, lenders, and other third parties to ensure smooth transactions.
- Conducting property searches and handling Land Registry applications.
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring compliance with all regulatory requirements.

About You:
- Previous experience in residential conveyancing is essential.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple files effectively.
- Excellent communication skills and a client-focused approach.
- Proficiency in case management systems and Microsoft Office.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Opportunities for career progression and professional development.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.

How to Apply:

Please submit an up to date copy of your CV or get in touch with Zoe King at Reed for more information.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Payroll Administrator

Glasgow Competitive Salary + Benefits Full-Time Permanent

A well-established and growing accountancy practice based in the South Side of Glasgow, are seeking an experienced Payroll Administrator to join its team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a payroll professional looking to develop their career within a supportive practice environment, working with a varied portfolio of clients across multiple sectors.

The Role

As Payroll Administrator, you will play a key role in delivering accurate and timely payroll services to a diverse client base. You will be responsible for managing payroll processes whilst ensuring compliance with relevant legislation and maintaining excellent client relationships.

Duties will include:
- Processing weekly, fortnightly and monthly payrolls
- Calculating salaries, overtime, bonuses, commissions and statutory payments
- Managing pension contributions and auto-enrolment requirements
- Submitting RTI information to HMRC
- Processing new starters, leavers and payroll amendments
- Handling SSP, SMP, SPP and other statutory payments
- Producing payroll reports and reconciliations
- Responding to client payroll queries in a professional and timely manner
- Ensuring payroll records are accurate and maintained in line with current legislation

About You

The successful candidate will have:
- Previous payroll experience, ideally within an accountancy practice or bureau environment
- Strong knowledge of payroll legislation and HMRC requirements
- Experience using payroll software packages
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Good communication and client-facing abilities
- A proactive and professional approach to work
- The ability to manage multiple deadlines effectively

Payroll qualifications are advantageous but not essential for candidates with relevant experience.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary dependent on experience
- Flexible and supportive working environment
- Ongoing training and professional development
- Opportunity to work with a wide range of clients
- Friendly and collaborative team culture
- Long-term career progression opportunities

Apply

If you are an experienced Payroll Administrator looking for your next opportunity with a respected accountancy practice in the Glasgow area, please apply with an up to date copy of your CV or get in touch with Zoe King at Reed for more information.

title: Claims Handler
description:
At Davies people are at the heart of all we do, out values state that we succeed together, and it is this, that makes the business a great place to work! You will be valued and supported and receive excellent benefits including but not limited to:
- Exclusive Rewards Platform - Enjoy discounts at over 800 retailers.
- Generous Holiday Allowance - Start with 25 days of holiday, in addition to UK bank holidays, with the potential to increase over time and the flexibility to buy up to 5 additional days per year.
- Professional Growth - Benefit from ongoing development opportunities, training programs, and support in obtaining professional qualifications.

Our Opportunity: 12 month fixed term contract

Davies is on the lookout for an experienced Claims Handler to enhance our growing Casualty team. This role offers a stimulating environment where the selected individual will be joining a committed team, providing a first-class proactive claims handling service to major clients.

We at Davies hold in high regard the transferable skills and attributes that you can contribute to the position. Although having a background in the industry is advantageous, it is not essential as we will provide you with full training and support when you start with us.

What will your day look like:
- Liaison: Communicate with insurers, policyholders, and brokers.
- Investigation: Handle allocated claims, either from your desk or by referring them to a field adjuster for on-site investigation when necessary.
- Evidence Gathering: Obtain all relevant evidence and documentation.
- Resolution: Determine appropriate actions to resolve each case.
- Reporting: Prepare detailed reports, advising on policy indemnity, legal liability, quantum, and tactics as needed.
- Negotiation: Negotiate settlements within agreed authority limits.
- Professional Correspondence: Maintain proactive communication with all parties involved.
- Adherence to Procedures: Handle cases according to documented procedures and client requirements.
- Reserve Management: Regularly review and maintain proper reserves.
- Continuous Learning: Stay updated on technical changes relevant to your role, including participating in company facilitated training programs.

Knowledge and Abilities:
- Proficiency in managing Claims from cradle to grave.
- Experience managing Property Claims.
- Experience with the investigation of Liability Claims.
- Knowledge of how to value injury claims.
- Understanding of Civil Procedure Rules and the Claims Portal.
- Commitment to delivering outstanding customer service.
- Collaborative team player.
- Management of personal caseload.
- Demonstrated adaptability and versatility.

Desirable:
- Experience in managing Employer's Liability (EL) & Public Liability (PL) claims.
- Familiarity with reserving strategies.
- Exceptional communication abilities across various levels.
- This role is tailored for individuals who are eager to apply their claim handling expertise and are ready to grow within a forward-thinking company. If you possess the essential skills and are looking for a challenging yet rewarding career, Davies welcomes your application.

Benefits

Career & Purpose
- Davies Innovation Lab
- Leadership training programme
- Funding for professional qualifications
- Thrive at Davies; learning opportunities

Environmental & Social
- The Davies Foundation
- Local charity funding
- Pennies To Heaven
- Employee Resource Groups
- Employee volunteering programme

Financial Health
- Pension, 5% employee and 5% employer contribution
- My Choices at Davies provides; High Street discounts and Financial wellbeing hub
- Life assurance: x 4
- Refer a Friend
- Cycle to Work Scheme
- Lease car salary sacrifice
- Davies Incentive Plan
- Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption pay

Mental, Physical & Emotional Wellbeing
- Wellbeing centre; move, munch, money & mind focus
- Discounts with 100's of UK retailers
- EAP; 24/7 confidential helpline
- 25 days holiday, increases to 26 days after 5 years and 27 after 10 years
- Flexible working
- Dress for your day
- Inclusive employment policies eg. Menopause, fostering friendly, fertility, sabbatical policy and baby loss and miscarriage
- Flexible benefits include; holiday purchase plan and a opportunity to purchase heath cash plan and BUPA dental plan

title: Claims Handler
description:
An experienced Claims Handler is required by a leading Independent Global Loss Adjusters to join their established and experienced Claims Team where you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of Property and Liability Claims cradle to grave for both the UK and Europe.

Key responsibilities:
- Investigating, negotiating and agreeing settlement of claims
- Liaising with the Insured, Insurers/Brokers on a day-to-day basis
- Liaise with stakeholders overseas
- Produce reports
- Ensure time reporting and billing is compliant
- Liaise closely with the team of Field Adjusters where appropriate
- Attend Client review meetings

About you:
- Previous Claims handling experience including caseload management
- Experience of handling Property Claims covering all general perils
- Exceptional communication skills both written and verbal
- Strong relationship management skills with the ability of establishing good working relationships with the team, colleagues and 3rd parties
- Proven capability in negotiation, decision making and problem-solving skills.
- Thrive in a high-pressured working environment
- Be driven to meet and exceed targets
- Industry qualifications, working towards or be keen to study and work towards
- Be happy to work from on office base 2/3 days per week

Salary and Benefits:
- Competitive Annual Basic Salary

Full support towards Industry qualification as well as support towards career progression and development
- Hours are Monday to Friday 9.00am-5.00pm
- 25 days holiday per annum plus bank holidays
- Healthcare Scheme
- Pension - 8% Employer, 2 % Employee
- Life Assurance
- Health Insurance

title: Service Desk Analyst - Telephony, Avaya
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Service Desk Analyst - Telephony, Avaya

£market rate (Inside IR35)

Glasgow (5days onsite)

3/6 months initially

This role will provide technical support for telephony services, covering hardware and software faults, installations, moves and changes, system maintenance, call recording and contact centre applications.

Key Responsibilities
- Resolve telecoms-related service desk incidents and technical issues.
- Support telephony installations, moves, changes and site audits.
- Maintain telecoms documentation, configuration records and databases.
- Configure and support Avaya Communication Manager, NICE Call Recording and Avaya Contact Centre.
- Assist with upgrades, rebuilds and system changes.
- Manage user access and provide technical support to users.
- Identify recurring faults and escalate where appropriate.
- Liaise with internal teams, users and external representatives.

Main Requirements
- HNC qualification or equivalent telecoms/eHealth experience.
- Knowledge of telephony infrastructure, patch panels and distribution points.
- Experience with Avaya, NICE Call Recording and contact centre systems.
- Strong troubleshooting, communication and customer service skills.
- Comfortable working across multiple sites and managing priorities.

If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.
